sahneler.metin: One morning, millions of Windows computers crashed at the same time.
Suddenly airlines, banks and hospitals around the world went dark.
A security company had pushed out a small configuration file.
Its software ran deep inside the operating system.
The file caused an out-of-bounds memory read.
About eight and a half million machines crashed and couldn't restart properly.
A fix came within hours, but many needed manual repair.
It pushed calls for staged rollouts and better testing.

aciklama:
CrowdStrike crashed millions of Windows computers worldwide. The cause: an out-of-bounds memory read in kernel-level security software causing crashes on boot.

#shorts #engineering #software
soru: How much power should security software have?
